description_en: Assigns a cloud computer to end users and removes all original end users of the cloud computer
description_zh: 将云电脑分配给指定用户，同时移除该云电脑此前已有的所有授权用户
kebab_example: aliyun ecd modify-entitlement --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --desktop-id ecd-7w78ozhjcwa3u0000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyEntitlement

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud computer
parameters.name: desktop_id

parameters.help_en: The username IDs. End users specified by this parameter become the end users of the cloud computer, and the original end users of the cloud computer are removed. You can specify 1 to 100 IDs
parameters.help_zh: 用户名列表。该列表中的用户将成为指定云电脑的授权用户，该云电脑此前已有的授权用户将被移除。可设置1~100个用户名
parameters.name: end_user_id
